scope: Existing captured screenshots were opened for visual/provenance inspection. No browser or test was run during publication packaging.
group_findings: Nine successful group screenshot aliases inspected at 1440 and 390 widths; formula SVG, original synthetic lesson text, question text and explicitly read synthetic private solution are visible.
All corresponding actual geometry receipts report no dialog/page horizontal overflow. Long numeric hashes wrap within the narrow dialog.
Both actual group calculator screenshots display BLOCKED/environment_unavailable, not successful arithmetic.
legacy_findings: Three original single-block screenshots inspected: synthetic unreviewed candidate, complete numeric plan and actual BLOCKED result remain visible; no new regression claim beyond the recorded two-case run.
failure_context: The retained first-run screenshots and accessibility context already show an enabled creation-kind combobox. The failure came from the new exact label selector; the test changed only to an exact accessible combobox role and kept default 5000ms expect timeouts.
tracked_png_findings: Four original M1 PNG copies inspected as synthetic interface fixtures, including synthetic session-version conflict UI. They contain no session credential; current files exactly equal fixed Git blobs. This is a point-in-time Git comparison, not four before/after snapshots of every native run.
privacy: No actual credential, CSRF value, private account or learner data observed. Synthetic private solution is original fixture content, not a real learner record.
limits: Visual inspection does not establish mathematics, source authority, teaching quality, hosted-provider compatibility, review, publication or full M6.1 completion.
